correctness.rationale: Unitary Fourier decomposition gives exact positive 2x2 determinants at all radii. Full Gram determinant has a unique maximizing squared radius M-1. Uniform Poisson large-deviation estimates bound both spectral extremes and yield a single convex-rate minimax F(rho); the endpoint columns exclude all escaping radius scales. Direct singular-value, determinant and rate checks in the packaged checker passed; finite tests are not a proof.

value.rationale: Critical derivative sampling halves site count while reconstructing every coefficient; its best achievable conditioning remains exponentially poor. The precise exponent 2/e and a unique asymptotically conditioning-optimal radius differing from determinant-maximizing radius provide concrete stability guidance and a nontrivial structural separation.
